about: Kronorium changes. steps: each key is a step (map-section-number) or a full walkthrough (walk-map-number); v = YouTube id, s and e = start and end in seconds, t = title, hide = video ids removed from the step, none = the step shows no video, add = more videos shown after the step's own. text: each key is a map, a section (map-section) or a step (map-section-number), holding only the wording that was changed; gone = that step or section is deleted. layout: where a step's video sits (right, left, above or below its words); * is every step.

asc-setup-2.t: Launch the rocket and open Pack a Punch
asc-setup-2.d: Return to the power room and press the red button. The rocket on the launch pad lifts off. The door below Speed Cola and Mule Kick now opens. Pack-a-Punch is inside.

cotd-door-4.d: A bottle frozen in ice hangs on a ledge above a walkway: on a railing, at the bottom of a staircase or at the bottom of a drop. It only spawns outside, on top of the PhD Flopper room, or on the power-switch half of the ship. One player stands on the walkway underneath, a second melees the ice from above, and the first catches the bottle as it falls.

cotd-door-5.d: Each floor of the lighthouse has a coloured dial: yellow, orange, blue, purple from top to bottom. Turn them so they read 2, 7, 4, 6 from the top floor to the bottom.

cotd-door-6.d: Interact with all four radios in this order, within a few seconds of each other. A light in the sky flashes Morse code when it works.
